senses.gloss:
(I)--a daughter of दक्ष and a wife of कश्यप.
1: भा. IX. 1. १०; VI. 6. २५; Br. II. ३३. १७; III. 3. ५६, ११७; ७१. २००; Vi. I. १५. १२४; III. 1. ४२.
Mother of वामन-Hari and other gods.
2: भा. VIII. १३. 6; VI. 6. ३८-39; VI. १८. 9; X. 3. ४२; M. १७२. 5; १७८. २०; वा., ९६. १९६; ९७, २३.
Was much con- cerned at the evacuation of अमरावति by gods, and informed her husband of her grief. कश्यप consoled her saying that it was all Hari's माया and everything would be rectified by His aid. Asked to the means of approaching Hari, कश्यप taught her the पयोव्रत। Observed the व्रत for twelve days as directed. Hari heard her prayers, promised to be born in her womb to protect her sons, and desired that she should keep it a secret. She soon waited on कश्यप and became pregnant with Hari. Then Hari was praised by ब्रह्मा.
3: भा. VIII. ch. १६ & १७.
Birth of the Lord described.
4: भा. VIII. १८. 1-११; Br. III. ७२. २२; ७३. ७५.
Changed before her into a boy-ब्रह्मचारिन्.
5: भा. VIII. १८. १२.
Worshipped for food and other things, while her sons the आदित्यस् are prayed to for attainment of heaven.
6: Ib. VIII. १८. १३-19; II. 3. 4; M. १७१. ५५-8.
Her desire was fulfilled by वामन. Pleased with his anointing, gods sent their praises to Aditi on the exploits of वामन.
7: Ib. VIII. २३. 4, २१, २७; M. २४४. 9-४८; २४५. ६३; २४६. ५८.
कृष्न took back the कुण्डलस् which had been taken away by Naraka, and सत्यभामा in her Lord's company bowed to Aditi and handed over the कुण्डलस्। At this Aditi embraced her daughter-in-law.
8: भा. X. ५९. ३८; Ib. [६५ (v) 6-१०]; Vi. V. २९. ११, ३५; ३० (whole).
प्रजापति caused the तेजस् of the अण्डम् in her गर्भ, and removing it at the request of gods, made it into two pieces, and finding it weak, placed it on the lap of the Sun- god (मार्ताण्ड): given to dharma.
9: Br. III. 7. २७७-94, ४६५.
A part of Mother Earth.
१०: Br. III. ७१. २३८; M. 6. 1. 5; ११. 2; ४७. 9; १४६. १८; १५४. ३५१; १७१. २९.
A mother goddess.
११: M. १७९. १५.
Worshipped in housebuilding.
१२: M. २५३. २७.
Mother of the १२ A1dityas the former Jayadevas.
१३: Br. III. 4. ३४; वा. ६६. ५५; ६०. ६५.
Known for strength.
१४: वा. ६९. ९२. Br. II. १३. ७९.
[page१-045+ ३०]
(II)--born of दक्ष and son was विवस्वान्. Vi. IV. 1. 6.
--a son of Sahadeva and father of Jayatsena; a righteous soul. वा. ९३. १०; Vi. IV. 9. २७.

--विष्णु; bore for the first time the गदा out of the bone of गदा-asura. He is व्यक्त, the whole universe appearing in him in the गया शिला; in praise of, by ब्रह्मा and शिव. वा. १०९. १३-17, २५, २७-31, ४१-42 and ४३-50; १११. १६.
--created by ललिता to consume waters due to भण्ड's अर्णवास्त्रम्। Br. IV. २९. ९२. [page१-154+ ४७]
--a name of विष्णु. Br. IV. १५. १८.
(I)--patronymic of विधातृ. भा. VI. १८. 3.

(II)--a name of सूर्य (s.v.);
1: Br. II. २१. 3; M. 2. ३१-4.
presented the jewel Syamantaka to सत्राजित्.
2: Vi. IV. १३. ११.

(III)--from आदान receiving waters and letting them off; कालाग्नि, पितामह and सोम, all प्रपितामहस्;
1: वा. १२. ३७; ३१. २९-35.
same as Rudra; see रुद्र।
2: Br. II. १०. २२.
(IV)--a division of the night. वा. ६६. ४४.

--sons of Aditi and कश्यप, originally Vai- कुण्ठस् and साध्यस्;
1: Br. II. ३८. 3; III. 1. ६१; 3. ५७-61, ६७-8; 4. ३४; M. १७१. ५५; वा. ३०. ८३, ९९, १६३; ३९. ४९; ६४. 2; ६६. ६०, ६६-7; Vi. I. १५. १२९.
Gods of the Vaivasvata epoch at the commencement of the first त्रेतायुग, known as Jayadevas;
2: भा. VIII. १३. 4; VI. 7. 2; १०. १७; M. 9. २९.
twelve in number; were known as तुषितस् in the चाक्षुष epoch.
3: वा. ६७. ४४; M. 6. 3; Vi. I. १५. १३२.
Names were इन्द्र, धातृ, भग, त्वष्टृ, मित्र, वरुण, यम, विवस्वत्, सवितृ, पूषन्, अम्शुमत्, and विष्णु।
4: भा. XII. ११. ३०-45; Br. II. २४. ३३-4, ७५; २६-42; M. १३२. 3; २४७. १०; Vi. I. १५. १३०-1.
Born of विष्णु as their overlord.
5: Vi. V. 1. १७-8; 4. 5; भा. XII. ११. ३०f; XI. १६. १३. Br. III. 8. 5.
Escorted Indra; vanquished Diti's sons, and vanquished by रावण;
6: Br. III. 5. ४८; 7. २५४.
came with gods to द्वारका to request कृष्ण to leave for Vai- कुण्ठ.
7: भा. XI. 6. 2.
One of the names of the first मरुत् गण।
8: वा. ६७. १२३.
Born with Rudras.
9: Ib. ६५. ६१.
Residents of Bhuvarloka.
१०: Ib. १०१. ३०; Br. IV. 2. २८-9.
Offered pre- sents (उपायन) at the time of the marriage of कामेश्वर with ललिता.
११: Br. IV. १५. २४.
Praised ललिता when भण्ड was killed.
१२: Ib. IV. ३०. 8.
[page१-155+ २७]
--the right of being born as sons of Aditi. वा. ६६. ५९.
--the यजुस् returned to possession of सूर्य when याज्ञवल्क्य surrounded them. वा. ६१. २१.
--the solar race. M. ११. 1.
--by this the divine weapons of कृष्ण went to heaven. Vi. V. ३७. ५२.

--Sunday, fit for अनङ्गदेव व्रतम्; in- auspicious for housebuilding;
1: M. ७०. ४६; २५३. 7.
devoted to worship of सूर्य, Candra and Agni.
2: M. ९७. 3-२०.

--a vow in honour of शङ्कर in the name of सूर्य; auspicious day is Sunday preferably with constellation हस्त; accompanied by gifts to ब्राह्मणस्: Relieves one from bondage of birth; practised by वसिष्ठ, Arjuna, Kubera, Indra in olden days. M. ५५. 3-३३.
--an उपपुराण। M. ५३. ६३.
--a तीर्थ on the नर्मदा. M. १९१. 5. [page१-156+ २७]
--seven गणस् of which three are without form and four are with form; above them are three भावमूर्तिस् and below them four सूक्ष्ममूर्तिस्। वा. ७१. ५४-6.
--a name of विष्णु. वा. १०९. १५.
--Ten thousand and six hundred श्लोकस्। वा. १०४. 7.
--earlier पुराण literature. M. १६४. १६.
--is कामक्षी. Br. IV. ४०. ४६.

--origin of,
1: Br. II. १०. 2.
described;
2: Ib. II. Ch. 9.
the primary creation.
3: M. 8. 1; ५२. 2.
